title: Manual From/Into Implementing Identity Conversions
pattern: Manually implementing conversion traits (like `From` or `Into`) for simple structural structs or newtypes, instead of using automated macros or lightweight functions.
why_bad: It clutters the file with manual boilerplate mappings that do not perform any validation or structural changes. In modern environments, these are highly repetitive and can be auto-generated or simplified.
detection: A manual implementation of `From` or `Into` that only assigns a raw value of a primitive to a newtype single-field struct.
counterexample: Complex conversions between distinct multi-field domain entities that validate invariants or parse raw external types.
source: Jon Gjengset, *Rust for Rustaceans* (2021), Chapter 1 ("Foundations - Ergonomics"), pp. 15-18.
